output.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.discount_amount), 0), 2) AS total_discount FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This sums the discount amount on orders with status 'completed' and an order date in 2025. I assumed the status value is stored as lowercase 'completed', since the status values aren't listed. I filtered on status rather than is_revenue because you asked specifically about completed orders.
